scripts.check: biome ci . && turbo run typecheck build test && pnpm api:check && pnpm check:packages
scripts.api:check: for f in packages/*/api-extractor*.json; do pnpm exec api-extractor run -c "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.api:update: for f in packages/*/api-extractor*.json; do pnpm exec api-extractor run --local -c "$f" || exit 1; done
